events.title: Full Play Group, S.A. v. United States, et al. and Lopez, Hernan v. United States, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the petitions for writs of certiorari for the cases Full Play Group, S.A. v. United States, et al. and Lopez, Hernan v. United States, et al. The judgments were vacated, and the cases were remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit for further consideration in light of the pending motion to dismiss the indictment.
events.why_relevant: The order is relevant because it records the Court's decision not to review the lower-court judgment.

events.title: Zielinski, Kira K. v. United States
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion of petitioner Kira K. Zielinski for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari. The judgment was vacated, and the case was remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit for further consideration in light of the position asserted by the Solicitor General in his brief for the United States filed on November 13, 2025.
events.why_relevant: The Supreme Court's decision to vacate and remand this case could influence the appellate court's reconsideration and the legal outcome.

events.title: Certiorari Granted in Monsanto Co. v. Durnell
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted certiorari in Monsanto Co. v. Durnell, limited to the question of whether the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act preempts a label-based failure-to-warn claim where the EPA has not required the warning. This focuses the Court's review on a specific legal question regarding federal preemption.
events.why_relevant: The outcome could clarify the extent of federal preemption over state-level warning requirements, impacting regulatory practices.
